newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Gas find in Senegal, estimated 10 bln cubic metres.
newsitem.headline: Gas find in Senegal, estimated 10 bln cubic metres.

text.p: Senegal's state company PETROSEN said on Wednesday natural gas reserves estimated at 10 billion cubic metres had been discovered in the region of Thies, 70 km (45 miles) from the Senegalese capital.
A PETROSEN official said the new field would cover Senegal's needs in natural gas for 30 years.
"Drilling led to the discovery of an important natural gas field with reserves estimated to 10 billion cubic metres," an official statement said.
In the same region, a gas field with reserves estimated at 500 million cubic metres was found in 1993.
